accepted.workload_contract: gateway health plus one CRUD request
accepted.hypothesis: Killing the api-gateway pod will cause the entrypoint HTTP requests to fail, as it is the sole ingress for the pet/owner/visit flow.
accepted.expected_invariant: All HTTP requests to the API gateway should succeed; no 5xx errors or connection failures.
accepted.validation_plan: Send a mix of pet, owner, and visit CRUD requests through the gateway while killing the api-gateway pod; observe request failures and error rates.
accepted.recovery_expectation: Restarting the api-gateway pod should restore service; requests may fail during the downtime.
accepted.weakness_surface: api-gateway is a single point of entry; no redundancy or load balancer is present in the topology.

accepted.workload_contract: gateway health plus one CRUD request
accepted.hypothesis: Killing the discovery-server pod will cause service discovery failures, leading to intermittent errors in the API gateway and downstream services that rely on it for routing.
accepted.expected_invariant: All services should be able to discover and communicate with each other; no service discovery errors.
accepted.validation_plan: Kill the discovery-server pod and monitor the API gateway and downstream services for connection errors, timeouts, or failed lookups.
accepted.recovery_expectation: Restarting discovery-server should restore service discovery; services may need to re-register.
accepted.weakness_surface: All services depend on discovery-server for registration and lookup; its failure cascades to dependent services.
